comparisons.peer_summary: The Corporation employs an Identify, Measure, Monitor and Control risk management process, integrated into strategic, capital, and day-to-day business processes to ensure timely risk evaluation and response.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Bank of America describe an Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework centered on the 'Identify, Measure, Monitor, and Control' lifecycle. Citi states its framework addresses risks through 'identification, measurement, monitoring, controlling and reporting of all risks,' while Bank of America explicitly names this process as 'Identify, Measure, Monitor and Control' and notes it is integrated into strategic and day-to-day business processes. Both disclosures emphasize the integration of these risk management processes into broader business operations.

sentences.text: Citi's ERM Framework encompasses risk management processes to address risks undertaken by Citi through identification, measurement, monitoring, controlling and reporting of all risks.
The ERM Framework integrates these processes with appropriate governance to complement Citi's commitment to maintaining strong and consistent risk management practices.

The Risk Framework requires that strong risk management practices are integrated in key strategic, capital and financial planning processes and in day-to-day business processes across the Corporation, thereby ensuring risks are appropriately considered, evaluated and responded to in a timely manner.
We employ an effective risk management process, referred to as Identify, Measure, Monitor and Control, as part of our daily activities.

comparisons.peer_topic: Enterprise Risk Management Framework and Components
comparisons.peer_summary: The company employs an enterprise risk management framework designed to identify, assess, monitor, and manage risks, built around three core components: governance, processes, and people.
comparisons.comparison: Goldman Sachs and Citi both outline a comprehensive enterprise risk management framework designed to handle all risks undertaken by the company. Citi's framework encompasses processes for 'identification, measurement, monitoring, controlling and reporting of all risks,' whereas Goldman Sachs describes a framework designed to 'identify, assess, monitor and manage the risks we assume.' Additionally, Goldman Sachs explicitly structures its framework around 'governance, processes and people,' aligning with Citi's statement that the framework 'integrates these processes with appropriate governance.'

sentences.text: Citi's ERM Framework encompasses risk management processes to address risks undertaken by Citi through identification, measurement, monitoring, controlling and reporting of all risks.
The ERM Framework integrates these processes with appropriate governance to complement Citi's commitment to maintaining strong and consistent risk management practices.

Accordingly, we have established an enterprise risk management framework that employs a comprehensive, integrated approach to risk management and is designed to enable comprehensive risk management processes through which we identify, assess, monitor and manage the risks we assume in conducting our activities.
Our risk management structure is built around three core components: governance, processes and people.

comparisons.peer_summary: The firm believes effective risk management requires individual responsibility for risk identification, ownership within lines of business, and a firmwide governance structure.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures highlight the governance and structural components of the risk management framework. Citi notes its ERM Framework 'integrates these processes with appropriate governance' to support consistent practices. Similarly, JPMorgan Chase's framework requires 'A Firmwide risk governance and oversight structure' and emphasizes that effective risk management involves 'Acceptance of responsibility, including identification and escalation of risks by all individuals.' Both emphasize firmwide governance structures as foundational to their risk management approaches.

sentences.text: The ERM Framework integrates these processes with appropriate governance to complement Citi's commitment to maintaining strong and consistent risk management practices.
The Firm believes that effective risk management requires, among other things:
• Acceptance of responsibility, including identification and escalation of risks by all individuals within the Firm;
• A Firmwide risk governance and oversight structure.

comparisons.peer_topic: Board oversight of ERM and risk management
comparisons.peer_summary: The Board oversees the ERM framework to ensure risks are managed soundly and has authorized committees within the framework to facilitate this oversight.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Morgan Stanley emphasize Board oversight of the ERM framework. Citi's framework integrates processes with 'appropriate governance' to support risk management practices, while Morgan Stanley explicitly states 'The Board has oversight of the ERM framework and is responsible for helping to ensure that our risks are managed in a sound manner.' Morgan Stanley further notes it has 'authorized committees within the framework to help facilitate our risk oversight responsibilities,' which complements Citi's description of integrating processes with governance structures.
